pages.en:
“——”

A torrent of light erases all that it touches.

Within it, the swordswoman accepts the end of her battle.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“”
It is a waterfall of light that eliminates everything.
Bathed in the light, the swordsman accepts that her battle has ended.

pages.ja:
「
これで終わり。私の戦いは、ここまでです」
それは誰に宛てたものか。
聖剣の担い手は膝を屈し、万感の想いを込めて光を見つめる。

pages.en:
“—It is over. This is where my battle ends.”

To whom are those words addressed?

The bearer of the holy sword sinks to her knees and gazes into the light with every emotion in her heart.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“This is the end. My battle is over.”
Who did she say that to?
The wielder of the holy sword is on her knees and watches the light with a flood of emotions.

pages.ja:
崩壊していく聖杯。
彼女が求め、彼女を救う筈だったモノ。
それを自らの手で壊し、ようやく、騎士王は自らの過ちに気が付いた。
一人の少年と、一人の英雄。
長い年月、永い理想の果てに捻じ曲がったあの男は、それでも少年のままだった。

pages.en:
—The Holy Grail crumbles.

The thing she sought—the thing that was meant to save her.

Only after destroying it with her own hands does the King of Knights finally recognize her error.

One boy, and one hero.

Though twisted at the end of long years and an endless ideal, that man had remained the boy he once was.
pages.mirrorMoon:
The Holy Grail is breaking down.
The thing she sought, the thing that should have saved her.
She destroyed it with her own hands and finally realized her mistake.
One boy and one hero.
The man that got twisted at the end of his ideal was still a boy.

pages.ja:
後悔は抱えきれぬほど重く、
罪は贖えぬほど深い。
だが決して折れなかったモノがある。
あの赤い騎士は、最期に、誰にも冒されぬ答えに辿りついた。
なら
自分も、前に進まないと。
傷を負い、剣から手を離した最期。
あの丘の先に、自分の意志で駆け抜けていく。

pages.en:
His regrets were too heavy to bear.

His sins ran too deep to atone.

But something within him had never broken.

At the end, the red knight reached an answer no one else could violate.

Then she too must go forward.

At the end—wounded, her sword released from her hand—she will run beyond that hill of her own free will.
pages.mirrorMoon:
His regrets are so heavy that they cannot all be carried.
His crimes are so deep that they cannot be atoned for.
But there was something he did not give up on.
The knight in red finally arrived at an answer at the very end.
Thenshe has to move forward as well.
The end where she took her hands off of the sword.
She will run past that hill under her own will.

まだ魔力は残っている。
無理をすればまだこの世に留まれる。
許されるのなら
彼らの行く末を、最期まで見守りたかった。

pages.en:
“—The contract is fulfilled. Victory belongs to you, Rin.”

The holy sword begins to fade.

Some magical energy remains.

If she strained herself, she could remain in this world a little longer.

If it were permitted—she would have liked to watch over them until their journey reached its end.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“The contract is complete. You are victorious, Rin.”
The holy sword fades away.
She still has some magical energy left.
She can stay in this world if she pushes herself.
If she canshe would like to see what awaits them in the end.

pages.ja:
「
ですが、それは私の役割ではない。シロウには凛がついていますから」
透化は止まらず、騎士の体は光に呑まれるように消えていく。

pages.en:
“—But that is not my role. Shirou has you beside him, Rin.”

She continues to fade; the knight's body disappears as though swallowed by the light.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“But that is not my role. Shirou has Rin.”
Her body continues to disappear and the knight vanishes from this world as if engulfed by the light.

pages.ja:
潔く、一陣の風のように。
聖杯を求めた一人の王は、一つの思い出も残さず、運命の丘へと旅立った。
pages.jaRuby:
潔く、一陣の風のように。
聖杯を求めた一人の王は、一つの思い出も残さず、運命の丘へと旅立った。
pages.en:
Without hesitation, like a passing wind—

the king who sought the Holy Grail leaves behind not a single memory and departs for the hill where fate awaits her.
pages.mirrorMoon:
Like a brave gust of wind.
The king that sought the Holy Grail sets off for the hill of destiny without leaving a trail of memories behind.
